name: rogueflight
description: Roguelite flying-machine builder. Build a craft on a grid, fly it with real-ish physics, hit escalating score quotas.

scripts.build:itch: vite build --mode itch --base ./ --outDir ../dist-itch && cd dist-itch && rm -f sw.js _headers && zip -qr ../rogueflight-itch.zip . && cd .. && echo rogueflight-itch.zip
scripts.itch:push: npm run build:itch && butler push rogueflight-itch.zip $ITCH_USER/rogueflight:html5 --userversion $npm_package_version
